metadata.title: CYBER-BRIDGE Requirement Catalogue - CRA Annex I, Part II (Vulnerability handling requirements)

groups.title: Annex I, Part II - Vulnerability handling requirements

controls.title: Vulnerabilities in the product identified and documented

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Manufacturers shall identify and document the vulnerabilities contained in the product with digital elements.

controls.title: Components contained in the product identified and documented

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Manufacturers shall identify and document the components contained in the product with digital elements.

controls.title: Software bill of materials drawn up in a machine-readable format

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Manufacturers shall draw up a software bill of materials in a commonly used and machine-readable format.

controls.title: Software bill of materials covering at least top-level dependencies

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The software bill of materials shall cover at the very least the top-level dependencies of the product with digital elements.

controls.title: Vulnerabilities addressed and remediated without delay

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Manufacturers shall address and remediate vulnerabilities without delay in relation to the risks posed to the product with digital elements.

controls.title: Remediation delivered through security updates

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Remediation shall be delivered by providing security updates for the product with digital elements.

controls.title: Security updates separated from functionality updates

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Where technically feasible, new security updates shall be provided separately from functionality updates.

controls.title: Security testing applied to the product

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Manufacturers shall apply tests of the security of the product with digital elements.

controls.title: Security reviews applied to the product

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Manufacturers shall apply reviews of the security of the product with digital elements.

controls.title: Testing and review carried out regularly

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Tests and reviews shall be carried out regularly rather than only once before placing on the market.

controls.title: Information about fixed vulnerabilities publicly disclosed

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Once a security update has been made available, manufacturers shall share and publicly disclose information about the fixed vulnerability.

controls.title: Description of the vulnerability provided

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The disclosure shall include a description of the vulnerability.

controls.title: Affected product identifiable by users

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The disclosure shall include information allowing users to identify the product with digital elements affected.

controls.title: Impact and severity stated

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The disclosure shall state the impacts and severity of the vulnerability.

controls.title: Remediation information provided to users

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The disclosure shall include clear and accessible information helping users to remediate the vulnerability.

controls.title: Coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy in place

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Manufacturers shall put in place a policy on coordinated vulnerability disclosure.

controls.title: Coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy enforced

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Manufacturers shall enforce the policy on coordinated vulnerability disclosure.

controls.title: Policy accessible to reporters

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The policy shall be accessible to persons wishing to report a vulnerability.

controls.title: Sharing of information about potential vulnerabilities in the product facilitated

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Manufacturers shall take measures to facilitate the sharing of information about potential vulnerabilities in their product with digital elements.

controls.title: Sharing of information about third-party component vulnerabilities facilitated

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The measures shall extend to potential vulnerabilities in third-party components contained in the product.

controls.title: Contact address for reporting provided

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Manufacturers shall provide a contact address for the reporting of vulnerabilities discovered in the product with digital elements.

controls.title: Mechanisms for secure distribution of updates

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Manufacturers shall provide for mechanisms to securely distribute updates for the product with digital elements.

controls.title: Updates delivered in a timely manner

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The distribution mechanisms shall ensure that vulnerabilities are fixed or mitigated in a timely manner.

controls.title: Automated delivery of security updates where applicable

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Where applicable for security updates, the mechanisms shall provide for delivery in an automated manner.

controls.title: Security updates disseminated without delay

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Where security updates are available to address identified security issues, manufacturers shall ensure they are disseminated without delay.

controls.title: Security updates provided free of charge

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Security updates shall be disseminated free of charge, unless otherwise agreed for tailor-made products.

controls.title: Advisory messages accompany security updates

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Security updates shall be accompanied by advisory messages providing users with the relevant information, including on potential action to be taken.
